views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS packaging_id,
  p.name AS packaging_name,
  pr.contains_id AS direct_contains_id,
  pr.qty AS direct_qty
FROM packaging p
LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr
  ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
views.description: Task: Compute the average of the total quantity per final packaging combination, where for each final packaging combination you first expand any nested packaging relationships to list only the leaf-le
